audit.whatIsWrong: The stored level chart gives Sion Levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, while the packet chart and every whys[] entry describe Shen controlling levels 2-6, and the matchup wins 53.96% over 2765 games.
audit.why: Sion is immobile and auto-reliant. Shen's E (Shadow Dash, 600 range, 18/16/14/12/10s) is hard CC, and hard CC cancels Sion's Decimating Smash charge; W (Spirit's Refuge, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) blanks the autos a taunted Sion is forced into. That trade loop exists from Level 3 onward, so Shen should hold rows 1-5.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 flip to Shen; row 6 flips to Skill (Sion is a real frontline threat at two-plus items but no longer a lane winner). Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes are Level 3 (full loop), Level 6 (Stand United, 200/180/160s), first tank item, and Sion's own Level 6 Unstoppable Onslaught (140/100/60s). All four entries are present and accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nowhere does the page state that Unstoppable Onslaught (R) cannot be taunted out of. Players who learn 'E-taunt cancels his Q charge' generalise it to his ultimate and die to it. Cooldown numbers for Soul Furnace and Roar of the Slayer are also absent.
audit.why: Sion's R is flagged terrain/hardCC and is unstoppable in Riot's own text — CC does not halt the charge. Soul Furnace is 15/14/13/12/11s, Roar of the Slayer 12/11/10/9/8s and shreds armour, Decimating Smash 10/9/8/7/6s.
audit.corrected: State the taunt/Q-charge interaction and explicitly except the ultimate; add the real cooldowns to the cooldown-window text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is generic ('your committal tool', 'your ultimate') with no numbers.
audit.why: Concrete windows make the advice actionable: a dodged Decimating Smash buys 10s at rank 1; Shen's E is down 18s at rank 1, so it must be spent on the Q charge, not chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.late says anti-heal is core but never says why.
audit.why: Missing-interactions flags both needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated: Glory in Death heals Sion and deals bonus damage on target max health, and Soul Furnace shields off max health — flat armour is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Named the mechanic behind the anti-heal instruction.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Decimating Smash: 10s at rank 1 — a dodged charge buys the whole window. - Roar of the Slayer: 12s, and it shreds your armour. - Soul Furnace: 15s — trade after it pops. - Your E: 18s at rank 1, spend it on his Q charge.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Full charge knocks up. E-taunt cancels it; a dodged Q buys you 10s.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace is down 15s at rank 1 — trade after it pops, not into it.

edits.before: Track Sion's Decimating Smash (Stun): Charged = knockup. Dodge it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: E-taunt cancels his Q charge — but not Unstoppable Onslaught, which is unstoppable. Sidestep that.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — build your teamfight around that. Sion carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — build your teamfight around that. Sion carry threat: 7/10 — his zombie autos heal him and hit for max health, so anti-heal stays core.
